content: Missed Dose: It is crucial to take every dose of this medication as prescribed and on schedule. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to obtain a revised dosing schedule. Storage: Refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for specific storage guidelines. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for you. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Uses: Cefazolin is an antibiotic used to treat a wide range of bacterial infections. It may also be administered before and during certain surgeries to prevent infections. This medication belongs to the cephalosporin class of antibiotics. How to Use: Depending on the specific product, this medication is administered via injection into a vein or muscle. Use this product exactly as directed by your doctor. The dosage is determined based on your medical condition and response to treatment. If you are administering this medication at home, ensure you have been thoroughly trained by your healthcare professional on preparation and usage. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. Do not use the liquid if either is present. For optimal effectiveness, administer this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals. Continue using the medication for the full prescribed treatment period, even if symptoms resolve after a few days. Side Effects: Common side effects may include swelling, redness, pain, or soreness at the injection site. Rarely, this medication may cause loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or headache. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Rarely, this medication may lead to a severe intestinal condition caused by the bacteria Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile), which can occur during treatment or weeks to months after treatment has stopped. Prolonged or repeated use of this medication may result in oral thrush or a new vaginal yeast infection. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of potential side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before using cefazolin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other cephalosporins, penicillins, or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Cefazolin may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. This medication passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as Coombs' test or specific urine glucose tests, potentially causing false results. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Additional Notes: This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as complete blood count or kidney function tests, may be conducted while you are using this product. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments.
